WHY THESE THREE AND NOT MORE — the split, measured before anything was written
(production write/read sites per family, tests excluded, over 4661 sources). Of the 21
VOCABULARY rows:
· 6 have BOTH a production writer and a production reader, so a determination
genuinely exists to be reported: adjacentTo, connectedTo, contains, supports,
connectedByStair, measuredAt.
· 2 have a writer but NO production reader (connectedByLift, decidedBy) — a typed
reader there is authored-but-unwired by construction.
· 13 have NO PRODUCTION WRITER AT ALL: partOf, unitOf, levelOf, servesZone,
precededBy, supersedes, branchedFrom, causedFailureOf, wasMitigatedBy,
exceededBenchmark, replacedBy, maintainedBy, decommissionedBefore. Nothing ever
records these edges, so no coverage mark can exist and a reader could only ever
return ok:false. Such a reader satisfies this gate's detector while changing nothing
any caller can observe. They are LEFT DECLARED on purpose: the honest statement is
"unimplemented vocabulary", and paying the row with a stub would convert a measured
gap into a green cell (tracker §-3 rule 5).
· the 13 STORE-FIELD rows are unmoved: their disposition is read from
gates/dependency-fields.json, and only POPULATE (written AND reacted) can answer at
mutation time. Editing that census without building the writer+reactor is the same
stub, one file over.
